basic_profile.bio: A UCSD alum who recently moved to Spartanburg for a new job in data analysis. I love trying out new hobbies, especially sports like badminton and tennis, even though I'm still a beginner. I work in a 9-to-5 job, which means I usually browse Reddit in the evenings. I enjoy listening to Freddie Gibbs during my free time, and I'm always on the lookout for new job opportunities in the tech sphere. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring local cultural events during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in data analysis and statistics, thanks to my education at UCSD where I majored in Data Science. I've also picked up a lot of knowledge through self-teaching and online courses. My interest in music, particularly hip-hop, has been cultivated over years of listening and attending local concerts.
